properties.name: api-endpoint
properties.description: Prefix for all REST API endpoints (e.g. api/v1).

properties.name: cors.allowed-origin
properties.description: Origin allowed to make cross-origin requests to the API (e.g. the frontend dev server).

properties.name: jwt.access-token.expiration-hours
properties.description: Number of hours an access JWT remains valid after being issued.

properties.name: jwt.key
properties.description: Symmetric secret key (HS512) used to sign and verify JWTs.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token.expiration-days
properties.description: Number of days a refresh token remains valid after being issued.

properties.name: recaptcha.secret-key
properties.description: Google reCAPTCHA secret key used to verify tokens with the siteverify endpoint.
